description:
At 1921 Movement, we are your premier destination for officially licensed HBCU apparel, merchandise, and gear. Empowering through design and honoring Black culture, we stand as a beacon of strength and unity, inspired by the resilience and heritage of Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs).

Our mission is deeply rooted in the rich tapestry of Black culture. 1921 Movement is dedicated to honoring the stories, struggles, and triumphs that have shaped generations. With a steadfast commitment to advocacy, creativity, and innovation, we strive to inspire change, spark conversations, and amplify voices that deserve to be heard.

Each piece of our officially licensed HBCU apparel and merchandise is more than just clothing—it’s a visual masterpiece, a narrative in fabric, and a vessel of empowerment. When you wear our designs, you don the armor of resilience, the cloak of identity, and the emblem of unity.

1921 Movement is more than a brand—it’s a movement. We merge advocacy, empowerment, and creative design to celebrate and amplify Black culture. Affiliates benefit from promoting high-quality, impactful merchandise that drives connection and community.

Payment Terms:
Earn a 3% commission on total referral sales when a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or uses your unique coupon code. Payouts are reliable and timely, ensuring a seamless experience for our affiliates.


Additional Information:

• Dedicated support with promotional materials and guidance for affiliates.

• Wide product range appealing to HBCU alumni, students, and supporters.

• Join a growing brand with a loyal customer base and high conversion potential.

Join the Movement:

When you partner with 1921Movement, you’re joining a narrative of strength, unity, and empowerment. Together, we honor Black culture, inspire change, and redefine the language of fashion.
